name: meritocracy-app
description: Full-stack Node.js + React application with Prisma ORM

scripts.dev: npx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --kill-others "npm run dev-backend" "npm run dev-frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build-backend && npm run build-frontend
scripts.start: npm run setup && npx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --kill-others "npm run start-backend" "npm run start-frontend"
scripts.db:setup: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy --config prisma/prisma.config.js
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npx prisma db push --force-reset --config prisma/prisma.config.js
scripts.db:dev: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev --config prisma/prisma.config.js
scripts.dev:stop: pkill -f 'npm run dev' || true && pkill -f nodemon || true && pkill -f vite || true && pkill -f 'node src/index.js' || true
scripts.prereqs: docker build -t vporton/fly -f deploy/Dockerfile.fly . && docker image push vporton/fly
scripts.test:icp:registry: mops build -- -Werror && node --test test/registry-pocketic.test.mjs test/registry-oauth-pocketic.test.mjs test/registry-attestation-pocketic.test.mjs test/registry-payout-pocketic.test.mjs
scripts.test:icp:vault: mops build vault -- -Werror && moc --package base .mops/base@0.16.0/src -o .mops/.build/mock-icrc1-ledger.wasm test/fixtures/mock-icrc1-ledger.mo && moc --package base .mops/base@0.16.0/src -o .mops/.build/mock-rounds.wasm test/fixtures/mock-rounds.mo && node --test test/vault-pocketic.test.mjs
scripts.test:icp:rounds: mops build -- -Werror && moc --package base .mops/base@0.16.0/src -o .mops/.build/mock-icrc1-ledger.wasm test/fixtures/mock-icrc1-ledger.mo && moc --package base .mops/base@0.16.0/src -o .mops/.build/mock-registry.wasm test/fixtures/mock-registry.mo && node --test test/rounds-pocketic.test.mjs
scripts.test:icp:assessment: mops check assessment -- -Werror && mops test assessment-domain --reporter compact && mops test assessment-llm-client --reporter compact && mops test assessment-stage5 --reporter compact
scripts.test:icp:shadow: mops build -- -Werror && moc --package base .mops/base@0.16.0/src -o .mops/.build/mock-icrc1-ledger.wasm test/fixtures/mock-icrc1-ledger.mo && moc --package base .mops/base@0.16.0/src -o .mops/.build/mock-registry.wasm test/fixtures/mock-registry.mo && node --test test/shadow-rounds-pocketic.test.mjs
